versions.content: BS field The value 0x00 and all values higher than 0x10 shall cause the abortion of the transfer and PduR_ FrArTp TxConfirmation shall be called with the result E_NOT_OK . If additionally Retry is configured, such values shall not lead to the abortion of the transfer . Instead, the frame shall be ignored .
